scope: 80 original states, descriptive only; original C1 and T1A unchanged
radius_rule: base=min(all 80 archived nominal radii, both detected first conjugate estimates); fixed fractions [0.25,0.5,0.75,0.90]; uses prior geometric bounds only, never correlation optimization
domain_limit: all common radii below nominal and first detected folding; numerical validity tested, not global certificate
geometry: identical saved M/f and geometry.py; checkpoints checked SHA; no retraining
primary_summary: max over angles of intrinsic max(1,abs(j/r))/min(1,abs(j/r)) at endpoint ri, pooled two phases of 512
secondary_summary: max over sampled prefix 0<t<=ri using 512 common radial intervals and same angular grid
nominal_comparators: original T1A disk maximum, common Jacobi512 both phases
nominal endpoint maximum from final row of the same stored arrays
nominal_CA: retain C1 admissible CA only; no CA for two invalid domains; no artificial zeros

numerical_gates.failure_policy: document state/radius INCONCLUSIVE, no replacement or radius reduction; no further adaptive tuning

auxiliary_angular_observables: endpoint K signed mean,RMS,maxabs,absolute CV,std/RMS,peak/RMS,top10% of K^2 by launch angle
fraction det<0.5; det quantiles; angular kappa quantiles

methods: paired differences versus both nominal comparators
correlations.bootstrap: 5000 cluster resamples of8 splits, retaining all eligible states in sampled block; percentile2.5/97.5; descriptive sensitivity intervals only due overlapping splits
correlations.leave_one_state_out: all available states, not selected after results
correlations.leave_one_split_out: all8; also within split correlations with n>=3

positive_cases.ranks: against all40 true, descending kappa; also full80 as supplementary
positive_cases.tail_rule: top4 of40 true (top10%), descriptive predeclared; no predictive/confirmation claim

residual_model.crossfit: leave-one-split-out; prediction clipped to training x range and extrapolation flagged
residual_model.large_rule: abs(residual)>log10(2), i.e. factor2 deformation error; also robust z using 1.4826*MAD reported without retuning

dimensionless_candidates: C_A*ri^2 at common radius, rank-equivalent to CA
fixed_area_analysis.candidate_prediction: same leave-one-split-out isotonic log-deformation; MAE descriptive only

confirmation: new states only; no T2 execution here; write exact future hypothesis/observable/direction/gates before any validation
persistence: atomic final files using scratch temporary files outside watched artifact tree; per-state archive then aggregates every<=4 states; stop on save error
